title: Micron earnings up next Are we prepared?

observed_trades.setup: Retried IWM today as it came back into the June lows and rebounded intraday, on his 620 setup, with crowded short positioning in the Russell as the backdrop.
observed_trades.entry_basis: 620 setup on an intraday rebound off the June lows
observed_trades.quote: I did retry some IWM today. I didn't go with the TNA. I did go with some IWM
observed_trades.notes: Explicitly IWM itself, not TNA. At 09:48: 'I did pick up some IWM basically on this 620 setup ... Stops that low of day'. Held overnight.

observed_trades.setup: Tried Intel again today; it would not get going from his buy point.
observed_trades.quote: I tried to pick up again some intel today, but with not much luck
observed_trades.notes: 'again' = a repeat attempt. Sold the same day (next row).

observed_trades.setup: Closed the Intel attempt the same day because it did not move from the buy point; would not hold it overnight.
observed_trades.quote: it just will not get going um from my buy point. And so I just won't hold it overnight
observed_trades.notes: Same-day round trip; ticker named in the preceding sentence ('some intel today').

observed_trades.setup: Continues to hold AMD while it stays above 600 and the rising 10- and 20-day.
observed_trades.stop: above 600 and the rising 10/20-day he sits; losing yesterday's low, 600 and the 10 SMA he peels a little more
observed_trades.quote: I continue to own AMD, you know, maybe not the world's greatest action today either
observed_trades.notes: 'maybe I peel a little bit more off' implies he has already trimmed, hence partial; no trim is reported in this video.
